lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you have a new home?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我在北京买了房子。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ zài Běijīng mǎi le fángzi.
lines.english: Yes, I bought an apartment in Beijing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xīn jiā dà ma? Yǒu jǐ ge fángjiān?
lines.english: Is the new home big? How many rooms?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Lí gōngsī yuǎn bù yuǎn? Zěnme qù?
lines.english: Is it far from the company? How do you get there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 不远。坐公共汽车二十分钟到。
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn. Zuò gōnggòng qìchē èrshí fēnzhōng dào.
lines.english: Not far. Take the bus, it takes twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xīn jiā hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Great! New home is very good.
